900.3.10(1435).explanation: Exception RD 1435 sets site specific rules for these lands: pre-1980 semi-detached houses and duplexes may be enlarged or replaced in kind, certain old houses may hold several secondary suites or be divided into semi-detached houses, and old detached houses with a 0.6 floor space index may be enlarged to 0.69. It also restricts platforms, vehicle entrances on narrow lots and parking location, and keeps former City of Toronto by-law 438-86 sections and by-laws 807-78, 325-84, 877-80 and 256-81 as prevailing paths on named addresses.
